reference_manuals.title: Integrated Pest Management Package for Rice
reference_manuals.publisher: National Institute of Plant Health Management, Government of India
sustainable_first_rules: Monitor pests and defenders before recommending treatment; use pest-defender ratios and economic threshold levels where available.
Prefer prevention, cultural practices, resistant varieties, natural-enemy conservation, pheromone traps, and biological control before chemicals.
For rice stem borer and leaf folder, consider Trichogramma release, egg-mass collection, seedling-tip clipping, stubble destruction, and field sanitation before chemical escalation.
Use chemical control only as a last choice after regular monitoring shows pests have crossed threshold levels.
reference_manuals.farmer_safety_note: If symptoms are severe, spreading fast, uncertain, or chemical use is being considered, ask for clear field evidence and advise contacting Kisan Call Centre 1800-180-1551 or a local KVK/agriculture officer.

reference_manuals.title: AESA Based IPM Package for Wheat
reference_manuals.publisher: Directorate of Plant Protection, Quarantine and Storage, Government of India
sustainable_first_rules: Conduct AESA in the morning and decide from field situation, pest count, natural enemies, weather, disease severity, weeds, and rodent damage.
Avoid calendar-based pesticide application; prefer resistant varieties, seed treatment, balanced nutrition, sanitation, biological control, pheromone traps, and mechanical/cultural controls.
Do not apply micronutrients without soil-test or clear deficiency evidence; avoid imbalanced fertilizer use.
Protect pollinators and natural enemies; avoid spraying during bee-active morning hours and avoid chemicals soon after parasitoid release.
reference_manuals.farmer_safety_note: If symptoms are severe, spreading fast, uncertain, or chemical use is being considered, ask for clear field evidence and advise contacting Kisan Call Centre 1800-180-1551 or a local KVK/agriculture officer.
